name: Baited for Success

angles.text: As an Alliance member, you help secure the waters for local fishing and reduce the aggressive murloc population.
As a rogue, you can appreciate poison tailored to control troublesome murlocs.

faq.answer: Remy prepares poisoned bait for Jason Mathers and promises to explain how to use it when Mathers comes by later that day.
faq.q: Who prepared the bait for Jason Mathers?

aliases: why does jason mathers need bait
faq.answer: Local murlocs disrupt Jason Mathers's fishing, making it hard to sell his catch. The bait is meant to reduce their numbers without harming the fish he hopes to catch and sell.
faq.q: Why does Jason Mathers need this bait?

aliases: is the bait safe for fish
faq.answer: Mathers worries that fish might consume the poison. Remy plans for it to target murlocs while leaving the fish unharmed, so Mathers can return to fishing.
faq.q: Will the poisoned bait harm the fish?

aliases: where do i turn in baited for success
faq.answer: You report directly to Jason Mathers that Remy is preparing the bait.
Murlocs disrupt the fishing waters, making it dangerous or impossible for Mathers and other fishermen to earn a living until their numbers fall.
faq.q: What threat do the murlocs pose to Mathers?

aliases: what happens after delivering the message
faq.answer: After hearing from Remy, Mathers plans to collect the poisoned bait from him later that day and learn how to use it safely.
faq.q: What are Mathers's plans once he hears from Remy?

sections.body: Aggressive murlocs disrupt the waters where Jason Mathers fishes. He asks how to clear them so he can sell his catch again. Remy prepares poisoned bait meant to target the murlocs and let ordinary fishing resume.
sections.title: A Fisherman's Dilemma

sections.body: Remy prepares poison and promises to explain how to use it against murlocs without contaminating the fish. Mathers plans to collect it from Remy later that day. He hopes the waters will be clear and his livelihood restored.
sections.title: A Targeted Solution

summary: Jason Mathers asks Remy for help as murlocs disrupt his fishing waters. He hopes poisoned bait will drive them off without harming the fish he sells.
attribution: In-game quest text: Baited for Success
